The main takeaway from our work is that

the stoichiometric silicon-rich silicon nitrides prepared by high-frequency PECVD are of very high quality and that they are suitable for use in the production of high-quality silicon solar cells and other devices.

stoichiometric silicon-rich silicon nitrides are a viable passivation layer for high resistivity silicon, and that the injection level dependence of Seff is a useful diagnostic for assessing the passivating properties of the silicon nitride.
stoichiometric silicon rich silicon nitride films can be prepared by direct PECVD, which can result in low Seff values and long effective minority carrier lifetimes.
